caption: Mistaken rate of the contamination mask. Candidates the mask removes on the annotated micrographs, split by whether they overlap a CryoPPP-annotated particle.
note: Counts are on the annotated micrographs only (300 / 295 / 295 / 300 evaluated micrographs, not the full deposition). They are derived as the difference between the baseline and the +mask candidate sets: total removed = difference in candidate counts, `particle` = difference in true positives (matches to a CryoPPP annotation), `non_particle` = total removed minus `particle`. `mistaken_rate_pct` = particle / total removed. Overlap means a one-to-one match within the particle radius d/2 under the same matching rule as the 2D detection metrics, so `particle` is a difference of match counts rather than a particle-by-particle classification of what the mask removed; a removal can free an annotation to re-match against another candidate. This table carries no resolution, so the EMPIAR-10345 pixel-size caveat does not apply to it. That 10081 and 10532 both give 4,564 non-particle removals is a coincidence of two independent subtractions; recompute both if either changes.
